title: Hera intervenes; the divine chariot
intro: The Greeks yield ground. Hera and Athena prepare their chariot; the vehicle's parts get individual glosses below.

notes.text: ἀντιφέρομαι, press against / face in battle: 3pl impf; second οὔτε, “nor did they counterattack.”
χάζομαι, retreat: unaugmented 3pl impf; χάζοντο elided before rough breathing. πυνθάνομαι, learn: 3pl 2aor mid, stem πυθ-.
First … last; ἐξεναρίζω, slay / strip: 3pl aor. A catalogue-opening question.
Bronze / brazen; Ares as bronze-armoured war-god.
ἐπί adv., next / in addition. πλήξιππος, horse-driving (literally horse-striking), epithet of Orestes.
αἰχμητής, spearman / warrior: acc sg.
Οἰνοπίδης, son of Oenops; αἰολομίτρης, with flashing / gleaming belt: acc sg. μίτρη is a protective waist-band.
ναίω, dwell: iterative impf in -σκε, “used to live.”
μέλω: perf act ptc nom sg, “greatly concerned with wealth”; πλοῦτος gen sg, object of concern.
κλίνω, lean / lie: perf mid/pass ptc + dat; “dwelling beside Lake Cephisus” (Copais).
πίων, fat / fertile: acc masc sg; δῆμος here district / land, not “people.”
White-armed; λευκός + ὠλένη, arm.
ὀλέκω, slay: pres act ptc acc masc pl with τούς (711), Hector and Ares; ὑσμίνη, battle: dat sg.
ὢ πόποι, exclamation of alarm / indignation. Ἀτρυτώνη, Athena's epithet, traditionally “Unwearied”; etymology uncertain.
ἅλιος, vain / fruitless. ὑφίστημι, undertake / promise: 1pl root aor act, “was our promise to Menelaus vain?”
ἐκπέρθω, sack: aor ptc acc sg (ἐκπέρσαντα); ἀπονέομαι, return home: pres inf. Menelaus is the understood subject of both.
εὐτείχεος, well-walled: acc sg with Ἴλιον.
μαίνομαι, rage: pres inf; οὖλος, destructive / accursed, with Ares.
νῶϊ, we two (nom dual); μέδομαι, take thought for: 1pl pres subj + gen, exhortation. θοῦρις, impetuous; ἀλκή, fighting strength / valour.
ἀπιθέω, disobey: 3sg aor, negated. γλαυκῶπις, bright-eyed, Athena's epithet.
ἐποίχομαι, go about: pres ptc. χρυσάμπυξ, gold-frontleted: acc pl (ἄμπυξ, headband). ἐντύω, equip / harness: 3sg impf.
Venerable / august; feminine adjective with θεά.
ὄχεα, chariot: dat pl; κύκλον, wheel: acc pl, with καμπύλα, curved / round.
ὀκτάκνημος, eight-spoked (κνήμη, spoke); ἄξων, axle: dat sg; ἀμφίς, on either side / around.
ἴτυς, wheel-rim; ἄφθιτος, imperishable (ἀ- + φθίνω). This inner rim is gold.
ἐπίσσωτρον, outer tire: nom neut pl; προσαραρίσκω, fit on: perf act ptc nom neut pl. Bronze tires fitted over gold rims.
“A wonder to behold”; εἶδον, 2aor mid inf, explanatory after θαῦμα.
πλήμνη, wheel-hub / nave: nom pl; περίδρομος, revolving / circular. ἀργύρου: gen of material; ἀμφοτέρωθεν, on both sides.
δίφρος, chariot body; ἱμάς, strap: dat pl. Gold and silver straps support the body.
ἐντείνω, stretch / brace: 3sg perf mid/pass; subject δίφρος.
δοιός, two; ἄντυξ, curved rim / rail: nom pl. The chariot's two rails, not its wheel-rims.
ῥυμός, chariot-pole; πέλω, be: unaugmented 3sg impf. “At its end”; the yoke is attached next page.
